title: Wayfare Pass Desk Tool Card — Period Fee Refunds Under the Full Refund Window
content:
# Period fee refunds under the full refund window — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

A period fee is refunded under the full refund window when, no later than the last day of the plan's full refund window, the member ends the membership at once or moves up to the Wayfare Pass All Access Annual plan; the window is counted in calendar days from the event date of the fee charge, day 1 being the calendar day after the charge.

The window refund is booked against the fee charge that paid the period in force and names that charge.

The window refund is fixed only after every eligible trip completed in that period whose credit has fallen due carries its ride credit entry.

The window refund is not worked out before every fare of that period reduced by a fare adjustment carries the credit correction owed on it.

## The window, counted

- **Clock starts**: the date of the fee charge that paid the period in force, as the membership ledger shows it.
- **Counting**: calendar days; day 1 is the calendar day after the charge; the plan's full refund window gives the number of days.
- **Comparison**: the member's act (ending the membership at once, or moving up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual) falls no later than the last day of the window; the last day itself qualifies.

| Hypothetical fee charge date | Window | Last day of the window | Act on the last day | Act on the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 30 days | 1 July | qualifies | does not qualify |
| 1 June | 2 days | 3 June | qualifies | does not qualify |

## Capability of the tool

`refund_pass_period_fee_d96d0945` returns money on a membership fee charge under the full refund window. One call books one fee refund entry with refund basis `full_refund_window` on the membership ledger, dated today, naming the fee charge it returns and carrying that charge's billing period, and lowers the membership's net fees paid by the amount; the money goes back to the member's card.

## How it is invoked

The support desk books the window refund. The agent unlocks the tool with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pass_membership_id` | The Wayfare Pass membership reference number the fee belongs to, as returned by the membership lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `original_event_id` | The reference number of the membership fee charge being returned, as returned by the membership ledger lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `amount` | The amount returned to the card, in USD. | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; never empty. |

## Return

On success the tool returns a dictionary with `pass_event_id` (reference number of the refund entry), `pass_membership_id` (the membership concerned), `original_event_id` (the fee charge returned), `amount` (the amount returned, USD with 2 decimal places) and `net_fees_paid` (the membership's net fees paid including this refund, USD with 2 decimal places). The refund then shows on the ledger against that charge.
